dialogue.content: （こんにちわ。本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になりましたら初めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for coming today. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: はい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ。相談員です。今日はご相談して頂きありがとうございます。ご年齢と性別、どんなご相談か、お聞かせ願えますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor. Thank you for reaching out today. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 17歳　男子死にたいもうダメだ僕の社会的地位は地に落ちた辛い苦しい生きている価値なんてない死ぬしかないどうやったら死ねるんだろう
dialogue.English: 17 years old, male. I want to die. It's all over. My social standing has hit rock bottom. It's painful, it's agonizing. There's no point in living. I have to die. I wonder how I can die.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。死にたいくらいつらいお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... You're feeling so much pain that you want to die.

dialogue.content: 助けて
dialogue.English: Help me.

dialogue.content: なぜ死にたい。もうだめだ。と思うのですか？どんなことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Why do you feel like you want to die, that it's all over? What happened?

dialogue.content: もうダメだ
dialogue.English: It's all over.

dialogue.content: 僕の人生終わった
dialogue.English: My life is over.

dialogue.content: 終わったと思うくらい、絶望感にさいなまれているんでしょうか・・・
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're tormented by such a sense of despair that you feel it's all over...

dialogue.content: 僕は結局今回もなにもできない
dialogue.English: In the end, I can't do anything this time either.

dialogue.content: 昔からずーっと
dialogue.English: It's always been this way.

dialogue.content: 今度こそできると思って頑張ってたのにやっぱりダメだった
dialogue.English: I thought I could do it this time and worked so hard, but it was no use after all.

dialogue.content: もう生きていく自信がない
dialogue.English: I no longer have the confidence to go on living.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。頑張ったのに達成できなかったのは、とてもやりきれない思いでしょう。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be incredibly frustrating to have worked so hard and not been able to achieve your goal.

dialogue.content: 努力されたんですね
dialogue.English: You really put in the effort, didn't you?

dialogue.content: 頑張ってたのに、急に不安になって何も手がつかなくなった
dialogue.English: I was trying so hard, but suddenly I became anxious and couldn't get anything done.

dialogue.content: 前からそう
dialogue.English: It's been like this before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。昔から、そういう場面があったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've had situations like this in the past.

dialogue.content: 黒い世界にひきずりこまれていく
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm being dragged into a dark world.

dialogue.content: 中学受験の時もそう
dialogue.English: It was the same during my junior high entrance exams, too.

dialogue.content: 転校して新しい学校でもそう
dialogue.English: It was the same at my new school after I transferred.

dialogue.content: そして今回の大学受験もそう
dialogue.English: And now it's happening with my university entrance exams.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。受験があったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So you had exams.

dialogue.content: 大学受験、もうできない
dialogue.English: I can't do the university entrance exams anymore.

dialogue.content: 何も手がつかないから
dialogue.English: Because I can't focus on anything.

dialogue.content: とてもおつらい経験をしてきたんですね。でも、なんとか頑張ってこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: You've been through some very painful experiences, but you've managed to persevere somehow.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってきた
dialogue.English: I have persevered.

dialogue.content: もう乗り越えられたと思った
dialogue.English: I thought I had finally overcome it.

dialogue.content: なのに、また何もできなくなってしまった
dialogue.English: But now, I can't do anything again.

dialogue.content: 僕の心は折れた
dialogue.English: My spirit is broken.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・とても強い不安を感じて、どうにも出来ないお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... You're feeling such intense anxiety that you feel helpless.

dialogue.content: いつもこう。きっとこれからもこう。僕は大学にも行けないし、仕事にもつけない
dialogue.English: It's always like this. I'm sure it will always be this way. I won't be able to go to university or get a job.

dialogue.content: 友達は皆大学に行って仕事に就くだろう
dialogue.English: All my friends will go to university and get jobs.

dialogue.content: 僕は落伍者だ
dialogue.English: I'm a failure.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・、なぜ、僕は大学にもいけないし、仕事にもつけない。落語者だ・・・と思ってしまうのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... What leads you to think, “I won't be able to go to university or get a job; I'm a failure”?

dialogue.content: やろうと思っても何も手につかないんだ
dialogue.English: Even when I try to do it, I can't focus on anything.

dialogue.content: 受験は無理
dialogue.English: The exams are impossible.

dialogue.content: 社会でもきっと生きていけない
dialogue.English: I'm sure I won't be able to survive in society either.

dialogue.content: 僕には何かが欠けているんだ
dialogue.English: There's something missing in me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。何も手につかないって言うのは、とてももやもやしますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Not being able to focus on anything must feel very frustrating and unsettling.

dialogue.content: やらなくちゃいけないんだ
dialogue.English: I have to do it.

dialogue.content: なのにできないんだ
dialogue.English: And yet I can't.

dialogue.content: だから苦しんでいるのに
dialogue.English: That's why I'm suffering.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。やらなきゃいけないのに、できないのは、とても歯がゆい気持ちになりますし、苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be very vexing and painful to know you have to do something but be unable to.

dialogue.content: 押しつぶされて、死んでしまいそうだ
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm being crushed to death.

dialogue.content: いつごろから、そういう気持ちが起こってきたんですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: この苦しみから解放されるには死ぬしかない
dialogue.English: The only way to be free from this suffering is to die.

dialogue.content: 学校がコロナでリモート授業になってから
dialogue.English: It started when my school switched to remote classes because of COVID.

dialogue.content: 友達とも先生とも会えず、僕はひとりぼっちだった
dialogue.English: I couldn't see my friends or teachers, and I was all alone.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね。それは寂しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been lonely.

dialogue.content: 1人だと不安に襲われて、とにかくくるあひい
dialogue.English: When I'm alone, I'm overwhelmed by anxiety; it's just unbearably painful.

dialogue.content: 苦しい
dialogue.English: It's agonizing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ひとりで受験に挑むのは、寂しいし、苦しいと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Facing exams alone must be lonely and painful.

dialogue.content: 私も、不安になるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's completely natural to feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 今まで頑張ってこられたのに、急に一人ぼっちになって、相談もできないんですよね。
dialogue.English: You've been working so hard, and then suddenly you're all alone and can't even talk to anyone about it.

dialogue.content: 僕は外国の学校に行っているんです
dialogue.English: I go to school in a foreign country.

dialogue.content: リモートの時は皆それぞれ親のいる国に返され
dialogue.English: During remote learning, everyone was sent back to their parents' countries.

dialogue.content: 僕も親のいる外国に戻った
dialogue.English: I also went back to the foreign country where my parents live.

dialogue.content: でもその国には誰1人友達はいない
dialogue.English: But I don't have a single friend in that country.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは心細いですね。。
dialogue.English: I see, that must feel very isolating.

dialogue.content: 外国の学校は寮だったから、いつもまわりに友達と先生がいた
dialogue.English: My school abroad was a boarding school, so I always had friends and teachers around me.

dialogue.content: 僕は皆から期待されていた
dialogue.English: Everyone had high expectations for me.

dialogue.content: 勉強が人一倍できたから
dialogue.English: Because I was exceptionally good at my studies.

dialogue.content: だから僕も自分なら難関大学に入れるだろうと思っていた
dialogue.English: So I also thought I'd be able to get into a top university.

dialogue.content: でも、受験が近づくにつれ、不安で手につかなくなった
dialogue.English: But as the exams got closer, I became so anxious I couldn't focus.

dialogue.content: 皆僕のことを嘲笑うだろう
dialogue.English: Everyone will probably mock me.

dialogue.content: 僕の社会的地位は地に落ちたんだ
dialogue.English: My social standing has hit rock bottom.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・とても成績が良くて、皆に期待されて、楽しく過ごしていたのに、コロナでその環境がなくなって、孤独や不安を感じているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So you were doing very well academically, everyone had high expectations for you, and you were enjoying yourself, but then COVID took that environment away, and now you're feeling lonely and anxious.

dialogue.content: 自分はなぜこうなんだろう？
dialogue.English: Why am I like this?

dialogue.content: 当然そうなったら、とても寂しいし、孤独を感じて不安になりますよね。
dialogue.English: It's natural that you would feel very lonely, isolated, and anxious when that happened.

dialogue.content: 友達は皆元気に頑張っている
dialogue.English: All my friends are doing well and working hard.

dialogue.content: 僕みたいにはなっていない
dialogue.English: They're not like me.

dialogue.content: 僕がおかしいんだ
dialogue.English: There's something wrong with me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね。そうお感じになられるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's how you feel.

dialogue.content: 僕は病気なのかもしれない
dialogue.English: I might be sick.

dialogue.content: だからもう僕は何をやってもダメなんだ
dialogue.English: That's why I'm no good at anything anymore.

dialogue.content: 何かが欠けているんだ
dialogue.English: Something is missing in me.

dialogue.content: 期待されていて、勉強もできたのに、いきなり環境が変わったら、慌てたり不安になるのは仕方ないことだと思いますよ
dialogue.English: You had high expectations and were doing well in your studies; it's understandable that you would feel flustered and anxious when your environment changed so suddenly.

dialogue.content: でも僕だけ
dialogue.English: But it's just me.

dialogue.content: 人によって、環境は様々ですからね。
dialogue.English: Everyone's circumstances are different.

dialogue.content: 他のみんなは平気
dialogue.English: Everyone else is fine.

dialogue.content: 他のみんなは、自国に友人がいるのかもしれませんし。
dialogue.English: Others might have friends in their home countries.

dialogue.content: 人それぞれ、環境は違うと思います。
dialogue.English: I think everyone's environment is different.

dialogue.content: そうなのかもしれない
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: いきなり孤独になったら、慌てて不安になるのは自然だと思いますよ。難関大学のプレッシャーもありますしね。。
dialogue.English: I think it's natural to feel flustered and anxious when you suddenly become isolated. And there's the pressure of applying to a top university, too.

dialogue.content: そんな中、不安を感じつつ、今まで頑張ってこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: And amidst all that, while feeling anxious, you've managed to work hard until now.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってきた
dialogue.English: I have worked hard.

dialogue.content: すごいことだと私は感じます。
dialogue.English: I feel that's an amazing accomplishment.

dialogue.content: でももうこれ以上頑張れない
dialogue.English: But I can't try any harder.

dialogue.content: もう僕は壊れた
dialogue.English: I'm already broken.

dialogue.content: 不安に押しつぶされた
dialogue.English: I've been crushed by anxiety.

dialogue.content: 何故そう感じるんですか？
dialogue.English: Why do you feel that way?

dialogue.content: いつも今までそうだったから
dialogue.English: Because it's always been like this.

dialogue.content: 昔からとおっしゃっていましたね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned it's been happening for a long time.

dialogue.content: しばらくは頑張れるけど、突然不安に襲われて何も手につかなくなる
dialogue.English: I can work hard for a while, but then I'm suddenly hit with anxiety and can't focus on anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・それはつらいですね。。
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: そうなってしまった原因は、何があると思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think might be causing that to happen?

dialogue.content: 中学受験の時もドンドン成績が上がって、頑張ってたのに、急に不安が襲ってきて、ダウンしてしまった。
dialogue.English: During my junior high entrance exams, my grades were steadily improving and I was working hard, but suddenly anxiety hit me, and I broke down.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・。そういうことがあると、今回も・・と思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... When something like that happens, it makes you think, "Here we go again."

dialogue.content: 転校した時も、溶け込もうと頑張ってたけど、急にダウンした。
dialogue.English: When I transferred schools, I was trying hard to fit in, but I suddenly broke down.

dialogue.content: 大学受験でも凄く頑張ってたのに急に不安になって何も手がつかなくなってしまった
dialogue.English: For my university exams too, I was working really hard, but I suddenly got anxious and couldn't get anything done.

dialogue.content: これはこれから一生続くのだと思う
dialogue.English: I think this will continue for the rest of my life.

dialogue.content: 原因はきっと僕が以上だから？
dialogue.English: Is the cause because there's something wrong with me?

dialogue.content: 異常
dialogue.English: Abnormal.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・そう思って自分を責めてしまうのは、とてもつらい心情かと思います。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be very painful to think that way and blame yourself.

dialogue.content: 学校も親も期待しているのに、その期待に応えることはできない
dialogue.English: My school and my parents have high expectations, but I can't live up to them.

dialogue.content: 自分の希望を叶えることもできない
dialogue.English: I can't even fulfill my own hopes.

dialogue.content: もう死にたい
dialogue.English: I just want to die.

dialogue.content: 沢山の期待やプレッシャーの中で、苦しんで、つらいですね。。
dialogue.English: It must be agonizing to suffer under so much expectation and pressure.

dialogue.content: 死にたい、死にたい、助けて
dialogue.English: I want to die, I want to die, help me.

dialogue.content: どうなったら、あなたは充実感や満足感を得られますか？
dialogue.English: What would need to happen for you to feel a sense of fulfillment or satisfaction?

dialogue.content: もしよければ、一緒に考えてもらえませんか？
dialogue.English: If you're willing, could we think about it together?

dialogue.content: 勉強が手について、試験を受けらること
dialogue.English: Being able to focus on my studies and take the exams.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: そして、希望する大学に入って、自分の好きなことを学ぶこと
dialogue.English: And getting into the university I want and studying what I love.

dialogue.content: どんな事がお好きなんですか？
dialogue.English: What is it that you love?

dialogue.content: エンジン
dialogue.English: Engines.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは車？
dialogue.English: I see. Like in cars?

dialogue.content: 理系志望。車か飛行機、宇宙船のエンジン
dialogue.English: I want to major in science. Engines for cars, airplanes, or spacecraft.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。素晴らしいですね。好きな事、学びたいことがあるのはすごいことです。
dialogue.English: I see... That's wonderful. It's an amazing thing to have something you love and want to study.

dialogue.content: 内燃機関に物凄く興味があります
dialogue.English: I'm extremely interested in internal combustion engines.

dialogue.content: なるほど。どんどん進化している分野のひとつですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's one of the fields that's constantly evolving, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それを勉強できるとしたら、どんな感情になりますか？
dialogue.English: If you could study that, how would you feel?

dialogue.content: 僕の問題は、何も手につかない、取りかかれないこと
dialogue.English: My problem is that I can't focus on anything; I can't get started.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 自分は人間として何かが欠けている。この先、社会に適合することもできないだ。
dialogue.English: There's something lacking in me as a person. I won't be able to fit into society in the future.

dialogue.content: どうしたらこの苦しみから逃れられるのだろう？
dialogue.English: How can I escape this suffering?

dialogue.content: 分かりました。今までのお話を少しまとめさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Let me try to summarize what you've told me so far.

dialogue.content: 17歳のあなたは、外国の学校に通って、難関大学の受験を目指している
dialogue.English: You are 17, attend school in a foreign country, and are aiming to get into a top university.

dialogue.content: 外国の生活では、周りに友人や先生など、頼れたり話せたりする人がたくさんいて、成績もよく、周りから期待もされていてた
dialogue.English: In your life abroad, you were surrounded by people you could rely on and talk to, like friends and teachers. You had good grades, and others had high expectations for you.

dialogue.content: ただ、コロナで自国に呼び戻されて、突然孤独の中勉強をしなければならない環境に身を置いて、とまどいと不安を感じている
dialogue.English: However, you were called back to your home country due to COVID and were suddenly placed in an environment where you have to study in isolation, which has made you feel bewildered and anxious.

dialogue.content: 友人は楽しそうにやっているのに、自分はどうして勉強が手につかないんだと不安で、受験に失敗したらどうしよう。死にたいとおもってしまっています
dialogue.English: You see your friends seemingly doing well, which makes you anxious about why you can't focus on your studies. You're worried about what will happen if you fail your exams, and this has led you to want to die.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ただ、とても素敵なやりたいことがあり、その気持ちは私にも伝わってきました
dialogue.English: However, you have a wonderful goal, and I could really sense your passion for it.

dialogue.content: まずは、先程も申し上げましたが、人と比べてしまうのは仕方ないかと思いますが、それぞれご友人と環境が違います
dialogue.English: First of all, as I mentioned earlier, while I think it's natural to compare yourself to others, your environment is different from your friends'.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すこしだけでもいいので、離れている友人とオンラインでもいいので、お話をする機会をつくってみてはいかかでしょうか
dialogue.English: Even just for a little while, how about trying to create an opportunity to talk with your distant friends, perhaps online?

dialogue.content: 案外、平気そうに見えて、友達も不安を感じているかもしれません
dialogue.English: You might be surprised. They may seem fine, but your friends might be feeling anxious too.

dialogue.content: 状況は同じですからね。
dialogue.English: After all, they're in a similar situation.

dialogue.content: 僕の社会的地位は地に落ちた。だから友達とはもう話せない
dialogue.English: My social standing has hit rock bottom. So I can't talk to my friends anymore.

dialogue.content: 何故そう思われるんですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you think so?

dialogue.content: だって、僕は皆の中ではなんでもできるMr. Perfectだったから
dialogue.English: Because among my friends, I was Mr. Perfect who could do anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・。それだと、友人に弱みを見せるのに対して、抵抗がある感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see... So it feels difficult to show vulnerability to your friends.

dialogue.content: 絶対に見せられない
dialogue.English: I can absolutely never show them.

dialogue.content: だから、接触を絶っている
dialogue.English: That's why I've cut off contact.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。そう感じてしまうのも、なんでもできてきた身からしたら、当然かと思います。
dialogue.English: I see... For someone who has always been able to do everything, I think it's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: それなのに、僕は何もできなくなってしまった
dialogue.English: And yet, I've become unable to do anything.

dialogue.content: それなら、先生はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In that case, what about your teachers?

dialogue.content: 先生も僕に期待している
dialogue.English: My teachers have high expectations for me too.

dialogue.content: 学校全体が僕に期待している
dialogue.English: The entire school has high expectations for me.

dialogue.content: だからできない
dialogue.English: That's why I can't.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。だからこそ、力になってくれるんではないかと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. But don't you think that's precisely why they would be willing to help you? What do you think?

dialogue.content: もう学校にはいけないんだ
dialogue.English: I can't go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: いや、それはダメです。
dialogue.English: No, that's not possible.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。どんなときでも、強く、Mr.perfectで居たいと思われるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So you feel you have to be strong and be Mr. Perfect at all times.

dialogue.content: 私が今までお話させていただいて感じたのは、相談者様は、とても自分に厳しい方なんだなということです。
dialogue.English: What I've sensed from our conversation so far is that you are someone who is very hard on yourself.

dialogue.content: 友達からも先生からも
dialogue.English: For my friends and my teachers.

dialogue.content: もう僕はこの世から消えます
dialogue.English: I'm just going to disappear from this world.

dialogue.content: でも、厳しくしすぎて、そのせいでとてもつらい状況なってしまっているかと思います。
dialogue.English: But I think by being too hard on yourself, you've ended up in a very painful situation.

dialogue.content: 消えてしまっては、興味のあるエンジンについても学ぶことはできなくなりますし、あなたは世に貢献できる素晴らしい方だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: If you disappear, you won't be able to learn about the engines you're interested in, and I believe you are a wonderful person who can contribute to the world.

dialogue.content: 人に相談できないのも、自分に厳しくて、弱みを見せられないからかと思います。
dialogue.English: I think the reason you can't talk to anyone is that you're too hard on yourself and can't show any weakness.

dialogue.content: 人って、相談されたら、嬉しいものだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: You know, I think people are usually happy when someone confides in them.

dialogue.content: しかも、それが、Mr.perfectだったら、尚更嬉しいんじゃないかなと思います。
dialogue.English: And if that person is Mr. Perfect, I think they'd be even happier.

dialogue.content: あなたも、相談された経験がお有りなら、おわかりになるかと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: If you've ever had someone confide in you, I think you might understand. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 相談はまだできそうにありません
dialogue.English: I don't think I can talk to anyone yet.

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 自分はプレッシャーと闘っていて、環境に変化で耐えきれなくなったのだと気が付きました
dialogue.English: I've realized that I've been fighting against pressure, and the change in my environment became too much to bear.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはよかったです。環境の変化は、とても影響があるかと思いますよ。尚更、大学受験ですからね
dialogue.English: I see. That's good to hear. A change in environment can have a huge impact, especially when it comes to university entrance exams.

dialogue.content: お時間過ぎてしまいましたが、話足りないことはありますか？
dialogue.English: We've gone over our time, but is there anything else you feel you need to talk about?

dialogue.content: 自分のことを話したら、少しだけ気が楽になりました
dialogue.English: Talking about myself has made me feel a little better.

dialogue.content: それは嬉しいです。また死にたい気持ちになってしまったら、遠慮なく相談しに来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. If you start feeling like you want to die again, please don't hesitate to come back and talk.

dialogue.content: はい。どうも有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 少し落ち着いて、環境に慣れて、少しずつでいいので、慣れてくださいね。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Take some time to calm down and get used to your environment. Little by little is fine. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ご相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me.

dialogue.content: （終了させていただきますね。お時間過ぎてしまい申し訳ありません。）
dialogue.English: (We will end the session here. My apologies for going over time.)

dialogue.content: 有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
